info.title: v2.ams.get_shop_performance
info.description: Retrieve overall key metrics for all channels or specific channels.

get.description: Retrieve overall key metrics for all channels or specific channels.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel. Applicable values: - AllChannel - SocialMedia - ShopeeVideo - LiveStreaming

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end_date must be: - Equal to start_date for "Day" period type - Saturday for "Week" period type - The last day of a Month for "Month" period type. If the selected month is the current month, the end_date should be the latest data date - The latest data date for "Last7d" period type - The latest data date for "Last30d" period type Note: - The end_date must be later than the start_date and earlier than the latest data date - The latest data date can be obtained by using "AmsMarker" in the v2.ams.get_performance_data_update_time API.

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description: Order Type. Applicable values: PlacedOrder ConfirmedOrder: Note: - Placed orders are orders (COD and non-COD) that buyers have successfully placed, including paid and unpaid orders. - Confirmed orders are either non-COD orders that have been paid for or COD orders that have been confirmed for shipping (usually 30 mins after placing the order).

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: Period Type. Applicable values: Day Week Month Last7d Last30d Note: The start date and end date must align with the Period Type.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start_date must be: - Any day in the past three calendar months for "Day" period type - Sunday for "Week" period type - The 1st day of a Month for "Month" period type - The date that is 6 days prior to the latest data date for "Last7d" period type - The date that is 29 days prior to the latest data date for "Last30d" period type Note: The latest data date can be obtained by using "AmsMarker" in the v2.ams.get_performance_data_update_time API.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ams/get_shop_performance?access_token=access_token&channel=AllChannel&end_date=20250831&order_type=ConfirmedOrder&partner_id=partner_id&period_type=Last30d&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&start_date=20250801&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
